name: Gen-3 Alpha
description: Leading video generation model with fine temporal and motion control.
longDescription: Gen-3 Alpha is Runway's most advanced video generation model, capable of creating high-fidelity videos from text and image prompts. It offers fine-grained control over structure, style, and motion, with improved temporal consistency.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1/image_to_video",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $RUNWAY_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"promptImage": "https://example.com/image.png", "promptText": "A bird flying"}
)
print(response.json())
